palette.name: Soft Ivory
palette.role: Light background and text on dark

logo_rules: Use the horizontal combination logo as the default portfolio and professional lockup.
Use the MR orbital lettermark for app icons and social avatars.
Keep master logo artwork monochrome silver/ivory or deep-space black.
Use Voltage Lime as a restrained accent for highlights and separators.
Use the simplified favicon at 16–32 px; the orbital detail may not survive at tiny sizes.
Do not stretch, rotate, add extra shadows, or place the dark logo on a dark background.
Use the final brand line exactly as “Engineer the Essential”.
